TRADEX.Title: Trade: {a} ⇄ {b}
TRADEX.CompanionMissing: Trade Exchange: install and enable {title} for full {system} support. Until then trades use the generic settings.

Error.NoGM: A GM must be online to complete a trade between players.
Error.GMTimeout: The GM's client didn't respond. Try accepting again.
Error.Mismatch: The two offers didn't match when the trade was confirmed. Please review and accept again.
Error.ActorMissing: One of the trading actors no longer exists.
Error.SameActor: An actor can't trade with itself.
Error.NoPartners: No one to trade with: no other actors you own and no other players online.
Error.PartnerOffline: No player who controls {name} is online.

GenericQuantity.Name: Item quantity field
GenericQuantity.Hint: Path to an item's quantity in this game system. Only items with a number there can be traded. Example: system.quantity

GenericCurrency.Name: Currency fields
GenericCurrency.Hint: Comma-separated list of name=path for each kind of coin an actor holds, in this game system. Leave empty to trade items only. Example: gp=system.currency.gp, sp=system.currency.sp

Receipt.Name: Trade receipt in chat
Receipt.Hint: Post a summary of each completed trade.

SheetButton.Name: Trade button on actor sheets
SheetButton.Hint: Show a Trade button on actor sheets: where the system's adapter puts it (beside the coins in D&D 5e), otherwise in the sheet's header menu.
